Subject: PO requirements + invoicing cadence questions

Hi Vanessa,

We're getting close to issuing a PO for Redwood for our enterprise packaging pilot. A few procurement items we need to confirm before we issue:

- Healtheon requires a formal PO number on all invoices; can Redwood accept a blanket PO and reference multiple SOW line items on monthly invoices?
- Net terms: our standard is net45. Are you able to accept net45 on a standard enterprise contract, or do you require net30?
- Billing cadence: we prefer one consolidated monthly invoice per legal entity (with line items per BU). Is that possible?
- We also need a W-9, vendor legal name and tax ID to populate our ERP.

Attached: SOW_Healtheon_v1.pdf (draft) for mapping line items.

If you can confirm these, I can get the PO drafted. We also have a couple of packaging questions (quarterly vs monthly commitment buckets) — if there's a short pricing matrix that maps commit -> discount I'd appreciate that.

Thanks,
Laura Mills
Senior Procurement Manager
Healtheon Systems
procurement@healtheon.com

From: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa@redwood.ai>

Cc: marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, ben_carter <ben@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 21 Jul 2026 09:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: PO requirements + invoicing cadence questions

Hi Laura — thanks for the clear list. Short answers up front and then a proposed approach.

1) Blanket PO: Yes, we can accept a blanket PO and reference SOW line items on a single consolidated monthly invoice. We typically include PO number and one invoice per month per legal entity.
2) Net terms: Our default is net30. We can make an exception to net45 for enterprise accounts with an annual commit; we usually require an approval and a signed amendment for extended terms.
3) Billing cadence: Consolidated monthly invoice with line items per BU is fine. We can also include GL/charge codes in the invoice if you provide the preferred format.
4) Vendor details: Redwood Inference, Inc. — Tax ID: 27-1234567. I'll attach a vendor details form and a simple pricing matrix that maps committed annual spend to discount tiers and billing options.

Proposed path:
- You issue a blanket PO referencing the SOW line items.
- We sign an amendment that sets net45 on the base subscription for the pilot (pending final approval by our finance leadership).
- Monthly consolidated invoice delivered on the 5th business day of the following month with PO number and per-BU breakdown.

I've attached: PricingMatrix_202607.xlsx (shows commit tiers, packaging options, and sample invoice layout) and Vendor_Details_Form.pdf. If you confirm you can accept net45 and a single monthly consolidated invoice we'll flag this for expedited finance approval.

Two asks for you: 1) can Healtheon provide the exact GL/charge codes format so we can map them into our invoicing, and 2) would you consider an annual commit (volume) in exchange for a one-time onboarding credit? We can route a discount/credit approval if you can share target ARR or total commit band.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
vanessa@redwood.ai

--
Attachments: PricingMatrix_202607.xlsx (12KB stub), Vendor_Details_Form.pdf (8KB stub)

Hi Laura / Vanessa — Marissa from Finance here. Thanks for looping me in. A few operational items so we get the PO processed quickly:

- Please populate Healtheon's ERP PO with Redwood Inference, Inc. as the payee and the Tax ID Vanessa included.
- For a consolidated monthly invoice we will put all BU-level line items on a single invoice; to help automation please send desired GL/charge codes in a CSV (columns: BU, GL_code, description).
- Our invoice numbering convention requires a PO number field and a reference string for SOW (e.g., PO# 123456 / SOW 001).

On net terms: Finance can provisionally accept net45 for the pilot if there is either (a) an annual purchase commitment or (b) a one-time payment for onboarding services. If Healtheon requires net45 without commitment, we would ask for a short-term credit hold / limited-credit approval (and there may be a small fee).

Attached: Vendor_Details_Form.pdf (please confirm the Vendor Legal Name / Address fields).

If you send the PO draft (with GL codes) I can fast-track the first invoice creation and provide the exact invoice template for your AP team.
